title: terrain.terrain_cascade
description: M14E neighbor-chunk cascade event. Fires alongside a secondary `terrain.cave_in_triggered` (per VAL-M14E-018/-026) so renderer + audio can chain visual + audio continuity from the primary collapse to its neighbor. Reuses the M18 sabotage-scenario `terrain_cascade` family per spec literal.

primary_chunk_id.description: Chunk coord of the primary cave-in.

secondary_chunk_id.description: Chunk coord of the neighbor that received the cascade.

cascade_kind.description: Cascade discriminator. `cave_in` for M14E ceiling cave-in.

tick_delta.description: Ticks between the primary cave-in and this cascade event.
